consent.note: Template: consent stays EMPTY here. C6 behind the H7 CP2102: the DTR/RTS lines are not known to reach EN/GPIO9, so the loader is entered BY HAND (strap GPIO9 to GND, reset) and the recipe waits for the ROM banner declared above. The banner has no default: replace the placeholder from the ROM documentation before a run (a placeholder that is never printed makes the recipe BLOCKED). The strap must be released and the chip reset before it runs an application again. See docs/qualification-p4-c6.md.
